gap: Collision response has one degree of freedom: the boom only shortens, all the way to 0.16 m, so backing into any wall ends the third-person shot (measured: dist 0.162 m / avatarOpacity 0.00 against a flat rock face, 0.197 m in an inside corner). It never clips - worst lens clearance 0.2007 m by my own AABB math, 0/144 penetrating samples - but it also never reframes: no lateral orbit, no pitch lift over the obstruction, unlike BotW which slides the lens up a cliff face and keeps the hero in shot.
